ALL NINE anchored deliberately: from this row on, monster xp is a FULL share for the three (DM prerogative, DMG p.85 "strictly your prerogative"), while treasure xp stays proportional to their HALF share of the coin. Day 46, expedition 7 rounds 87-91. SIX SKELETONS, hp 4,4,3,3,2,1 = 17 hp. XP 7 + 1/hp each = 42 + 17 = 59. Fought in the (14,29,H) doorway one at a time because the slab is door-width; three destroyed there. BLARTHO TURNED THE REST at round 89 (12 vs the 10 a 1st-level cleric needs, DMG p.75), and area 9 is a DEAD END so they could not flee. The party then entered, spiked the slab shut behind itself, stood off at 15 ft and shot them to pieces while they faced the wall. THE LESSON OF THE FIGHT: edged and pointed do HALF. Dave's two big sword blows were 9 and 8 and delivered 4 each; Hask's single sling bullet did 5, more than four pointed hits combined. Blartho held his sling out of both volleys because the turning cleric attacking breaks the turn.

Day 46 rounds 256-259. Hask killed one, DELLIE killed the one that put Ista down, on exactly the 13 she needed. XP 7+1/hp on hp 4 and 3 = 21. ISTA TAKEN TO 0 for the second time in two expeditions. Both disease checks missed (81, 62). THREE CURE LIGHT WOUNDS were spent in this room and delivered 2, 2 and 1.
